PowPow Register 1.0.0 – Initial release focused on guiding users through PowPow (Bubble) account creation and subscription activation.

- Pure guidance skill: step-by-step help for new users from product introduction to account activation; no form submission or scripting.
- Covers: account registration triggers, troubleshooting common signup/activation issues, and payment/subscription activation instructions.
- Integrates product, registration, and subscription flow explanations with relevant screenshots and platform links.
- Excludes digital avatar creation and code development; guidance only, no direct service actions performed.
